parole.testo: From Livvi livvi, probably ultimately from Russian люди (ljudi).

parole.significato: A recreational lawn game played with numbered wooden pegs (called keila), somewhat similar to skittles.
parole.testo: The modern form of the lawn game was invented by Tuoterengas, a job coaching unit for the unemployed and a unit of the college now known as Salpaus Further Education, in 1996.
